  • Acoustical Wall Panels
  • S-4200 Tuned Absorber Panel - Acoustic Diffuser

S-4200 Tuned Absorber/Diffuser Panel

Capable of effectively scattering sound throughout a space, S-4200 Panels offer excellent sound absorption across a wide range of frequencies for proper room tuning. With their impressive blend of sound absorption and sound diffusion, they are perfect for auditoriums, studios and performance halls.

Request a Quote
View Data Sheet View Brochure

Applications

  • Schools / Classrooms
  • Auditoriums
  • Media & Multi-Purpose Rooms
  • Churches
  • Home / Pro Theaters
  • Performance Halls
  • Band & Choir Rooms
  • Studios

Sizing

S-4200 panels are offered in 1-1/8”, 2-1/8”, 3-1/8 & 4-1/8” thicknesses and standard sizes up to 4’ x 10’.

Easy Install

Our S-4200 panels can be installed using one of three mounting methods: Rotofast Snap-on anchors, Impaling clips or 2-part mechanical clips.

Finishes

Choose from Sound Seal’s exclusive Replay line of fabric. Replay features an array of rich colors sure to complement today’s interiors. Additionally, approved decorative fabrics from manufacturers including Guilford of Maine, Maharam, Designtex and Knoll can be selected, provided the material meets manufacturing requirements. 

Select a fabric & order samples from one of our manufacturers:

  • Guilford of Maine
  • DESIGNTEX
  • Knoll Textiles
  • Maharam
  • Hytex
  • Luna Textiles
  • Carnegie Fabrics
